title: Dispatch-weighted operational emissions
notes: Use actual dispatch by technology; do not approximate all thermal generation with a capacity-share-weighted average.

title: Consumption carbon intensity
notes: Declare whether denominator is gross generation, served demand, or demand including losses.

title: Avoid lifecycle double counting
formula_or_rule: Do not add a cradle-to-grave gCO2e/kWh value to a direct operational factor for the same generated MWh.
notes: Use stage-resolved embodied values or subtract overlapping stages before combining.

title: Storage charging attribution
notes: Keep equipment embodied emissions separate from charging-electricity emissions and losses.

title: Capacity-based embodied annualisation
notes: Valid only when the lifecycle intensity and DESNZ load-factor/life assumptions describe compatible technologies and boundaries.

title: Storage energy-to-power conversion
notes: Divide by declared lifetime only when annualising equipment stock; replacements require a separate schedule.

title: Transmission embodied calculation
notes: Requires project-specific quantities; no universal UK line factor is asserted.

title: Transmission operating emissions
notes: Inactive because the current PSM has no network or line-loss representation.
